decision: NEISO-RC-R R3(i) — the FFR-7C-style per-unit NEISO exit decode, executing FINDING-capx-neiso-rc-phase0-2026-08-30.md §6 R3(i) under charter docs/handoffs/capx-director-prompt-pack-2026-08.md §NEISO-RC-R
method: Fleet-basis facts are measured per EIA-860 vintage from the committed operable sheets (data/raw/eia-860/vintage_<year>/eia860_generators.parquet) against the fleet loader's status=='OP' filter (src/market_sim/data/fleet/eia860.py) — a unit ABSENT from a vintage's operable sheet, or present with status != OP, is not in that vintage's fleet basis and no screen can retire it (D-24 member rule clause (i)). absent_from_vintage_year is the FIRST vintage whose operable-OP fleet lacks the unit; the scorer applies the exclusion only to runs whose own vintage year >= that value, so the evidence is vintage-aware rather than gated on use_campd_bins (the ERCOT decode's CAMPD-bin-sheet gate does not describe NEISO fleet construction). Margin adjudication notes are carried from the Phase-0 finding's committed S-4b evolution-ledger extraction (results/ff-t1f-s4b-ara/neiso/NEISO/9a7f68fc7dcac931/) — reported for the record; none constitutes an economic exclusion (every noted unit FAILS its going-forward bar, so a margin-driven exit is economically consistent and the channel stays open, fail-closed).

2364_2.name: Merrimack 2
2364_2.model_bin: IN FLEET — OP in every measured vintage (2020-2024)
2364_2.note: Adjudicated margin note (no exclusion): coal fails its going-forward bar hardest of all fuels in the committed S-4b twin (net revenue 0.77 vs bar 58.50 $/kW-yr, 2027 screen), so a margin-driven exit is economically CONSISTENT — the in-window miss is coal's 3-year execution lag (decision 2023 -> execution 2026) plus the consent-decree instrument post-dating the 2023 vintage (2024-03-29), a lag/information censoring the D-24 member rule as signed does not model. Stays a member, fail-closed; the R4 decided-in-window diagnostic is where the lag censoring becomes visible.

562_4.name: Middletown 4
562_4.model_bin: IN FLEET — OP in every measured vintage (2020-2024)
562_4.note: Adjudicated margin note (no exclusion): oil is the screen's most-distressed fuel in the committed S-4b twin (net revenue 0.01 vs bar 25.00 $/kW-yr) — a margin-driven exit is economically consistent; the model's miss is the reliability floor retaining oil wholesale (2nd-cheapest $/firm-MW-yr on the FOM ladder), a mechanism fact, not target unreachability. No tracker instrument exists for this unit (the 2025 deactivation was announced post-vintage); stays a member on the economic channel.
